shared.planNote: Some features depend on your plan. Check the comparison before you start.

automaticClips.heading: Find moments worth sharing
automaticClips.body: Upload a video or import a supported link. Clipealo suggests segments with start and end points so you can review the context before turning them into clips.

subtitleEditor.heading: Make every word easy to read
subtitleEditor.body: Review the transcript and correct names or phrases before exporting. Adjust subtitle styles using the options in your plan.

verticalExport.heading: Prepare a vertical version
verticalExport.body: Turn a horizontal recording into a 9:16 clip. Check the framing and adjust it in the editor when needed.

brandTemplates.heading: Keep your visual identity consistent
brandTemplates.body: Organize the look of your clips with the brand options included in your plan. Check colors and captions before publishing.

latamAi.heading: Work with Spanish language content
latamAi.body: Review suggested moments and transcripts from Spanish interviews, lessons or streams. Your judgment is still essential when choosing each cut.

batchExport.heading: Prepare several deliveries together
batchExport.body: Select clips from a project and organize their download with the features available in your plan. Check each file before delivery.

projectManagement.heading: Keep everything in the right project
projectManagement.body: Group videos and clips by client, campaign or date. Return to a recording and find its results without losing context.

cliperos.heading: More time for creative judgment
cliperos.body: Start with the full video, review suggested moments and spend your editing time on cuts that represent each creator.

streamers.heading: Your stream lives beyond the broadcast
streamers.body: Turn moments from your streams into vertical clips you can review, edit and share with your community.

podcasters.heading: Make every great conversation visible
podcasters.body: Pick ideas from an episode, review the framing and prepare captioned clips for your channels.

coaches.heading: A lesson can start new conversations
coaches.body: Bring back clear explanations from classes or sessions and turn them into clips you can review before publishing.

creators.heading: Get more from what you already recorded
creators.body: Start with interviews, streams or long videos and prepare new short pieces in your own style.

communities.heading: Keep the event moments alive
communities.body: Find plays, reactions or conversations from your community and prepare clips to keep sharing them.

agencies.heading: Every client in context
agencies.body: Organize material by project, review the cuts and tailor each delivery to the brand using the options in your plan.

brands.heading: More pieces from one production
brands.body: Repurpose interviews, events and campaign videos into clips you can review before sending them to each channel.
